description: v3.6 V_year_saatchi_warm rollout dashboard. spec: docs/v3_5_step4_drift_monitoring.md §6.2. 12 panel — upstream ops + cohort + rate-limit + MdAPE D7 + audit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year_made_route = 'cache_hit') * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year_made_route IN ('cache_hit','fetch_ok','fetch_fail')), 0) AS cache_hit_rate FROM predict_logs WHERE rollout_cohort = 'treatment_5pct' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT year_made_route, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY enrichment_latency_ms) AS p95_ms, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY enrichment_latency_ms) AS p50_ms, COUNT(*) AS n FROM predict_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' GROUP BY year_made_route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

panels.title: Panel 3 — cohort assignment discrepancy (24h)
panels.description: spec §2.2 — < 1% target, > 5% pause. NO_BASELINE 시 T2a alert.

targets.rawSql: WITH active_artifact AS (SELECT artifact_version FROM predict_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND rollout_cohort = 'treatment_5pct' GROUP BY artifact_version ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1), train_dist AS (SELECT b.cohort, b.expected_rate FROM cohort_baselines b JOIN active_artifact USING (artifact_version)), prod_dist AS (SELECT CASE WHEN matched = false THEN 'unmatched' WHEN is_saatchi_warm THEN 'saatchi_warm' WHEN matched AND match_profile_source = 'saatchi' AND slug_in_warm_set = false THEN 'saatchi_cold' WHEN matched AND match_profile_source = 'artsy' THEN 'artsy_warm' ELSE 'other' END AS cohort, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS rate FROM predict_logs p JOIN active_artifact USING (artifact_version) WHERE p.timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND p.rollout_cohort = 'treatment_5pct' GROUP BY 1) SELECT t.cohort, t.expected_rate, COALESCE(p.rate, 0) AS prod_rate, ABS(t.expected_rate - COALESCE(p.rate, 0)) AS diff FROM train_dist t LEFT JOIN prod_dist p USING (cohort)

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year_made_route IN ('fetch_ok','fetch_fail','parse_invalid','rate_limited')) * 1.0 / 300.0 AS miss_qps_5min FROM predict_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.title: Panel 5 — concurrent_fetch_max (1min, server 합산)
panels.description: spec §2.1 — < 5 target, > 10 warn, > 20 crit. server/variant 합산 후 1min max (PR16a).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE year_made_route IN ('fetch_ok','fetch_fail','parse_invalid','rate_limited')) AS miss_burst_5min FROM predict_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.title: Panel 7 — MdAPE D7 overall (treatment vs control)

targets.rawSql: SELECT rollout_cohort, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs_pct_error) * 100 AS mdape_pct, COUNT(*) AS n_pairs FROM v_d7_predict_sold_pairs WHERE sold_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY rollout_cohort ORDER BY rollout_cohort

SELECT rollout_cohort, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs_pct_error) * 100 AS mdape_cold_pct, COUNT(*) AS n_pairs FROM v_d7_predict_sold_pairs WHERE sold_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND is_saatchi_warm = false GROUP BY rollout_cohort ORDER BY rollout_cohort

SELECT rollout_cohort, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs_pct_error) * 100 AS mdape_saatchi_online_pct, COUNT(*) AS n_pairs FROM v_d7_predict_sold_pairs WHERE sold_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND sold_source = 'saatchi' GROUP BY rollout_cohort ORDER BY rollout_cohort
SELECT model_variant, COUNT(*) AS n FROM predict_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY model_variant ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT server_instance, worker_instance_id, COUNT(DISTINCT artifact_version) AS distinct_versions, COUNT(*) AS n_requests FROM predict_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY server_instance, worker_instance_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT artifact_version) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT warm_artist_slugs_version) > 1 ORDER BY n_requests DESC

panels.title: Panel 12 — treatment vs control diff (rollout gate)

targets.rawSql: WITH per_cohort AS (SELECT rollout_cohort, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs_pct_error) * 100 AS m FROM v_d7_predict_sold_pairs WHERE sold_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY rollout_cohort) SELECT (SELECT m FROM per_cohort WHERE rollout_cohort = 'treatment_5pct') - (SELECT m FROM per_cohort WHERE rollout_cohort = 'control') AS diff_pct

title: VisionAI v3.6 — V_year_saatchi_warm rollout monitor
